roadmap.title: How you will use it:
roadmap.subtitle: Learn to enjoy life again with us
roadmap.card1Desc: Discover your emotional state through short tests and daily reflections. Our system evaluates your stress level and suggests personalized first steps. Nexie is ready to be your guide on this journey!
roadmap.card2Subtitle: You don't have to face challenges by yourself.
roadmap.card2Desc: Connect whenever you want with empathetic professionals in total confidentiality and safety. Online, in-person, or VR consultation — the choice is yours.
roadmap.card3Desc: Calm your mind with breathing techniques, share your voice or words anytime in the "Share Your Story" section. Track your growth with the smart notebook and restore your inner balance.

features.title: Find inner balance, understand yourself better.
features.subtitle: A safe haven for psychological support and personal development
features.card1Desc: This platform is designed to help you understand your thoughts, manage emotions, and navigate daily stress healthily. You are not alone. Choose a space you love and begin therapy.
features.card2Desc: Strengthen your psychological wellbeing with small steps. Feel more balanced with breathing exercises, brief meditations, and daily reflection.
features.card3Desc: Write your thoughts and discover yourself deeper. Track your emotional state and witness your personal growth by journaling daily feelings.
features.card4Desc: Share thoughts, receive encouragement, and feel that you are never alone in a supportive space with people who share similar journeys.

pillars.title: 6 Core Pillars of Psychological Health
pillars.p1Content: Develops the ability to recognize, name, and express feelings constructively. This forms the foundation of inner balance.
pillars.p2Content: Helps discover physical sensations and tension patterns in the body and gently release them.
pillars.p3Content: Breaks negative thought loops and builds a more positive, rational, and adaptive mindset.
pillars.p4Content: Establishing healthy interpersonal boundaries and nurturing empathetic communication.
pillars.p5Content: Fosters intrinsic motivation and helps you uncover what truly inspires you forward.
pillars.p6Content: Understanding your own authentic needs and cultivating the courage to say "no" when needed.

testimonials.title: Real Life Stories
testimonials.t1Text: Long-term stress and anxiety were making my daily routine overwhelming. Even minor events used to drain me quickly and I struggled to concentrate. After receiving psychological guidance, I learned how to manage my thoughts, and gradually my inner calm was restored. Now I feel much more stable and secure.
testimonials.t2Text: Prolonged tension and emotional neglect within family life had deeply affected me. I often felt anxious, exhausted, and distant from people. With psychologist support, I began to understand this condition. During sessions, I learned to express my feelings, set healthy boundaries, and apply stress management techniques. Today I feel balanced.

miniGames.headerTitle: Choose your preferred technique and begin!
miniGames.headerSubtitle: Make sure to learn the technique first

naturalSteps: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position.
Inhale slowly and deeply through your nose.
pranayamaSteps: Close your right nostril, inhale through the left.
Briefly hold your breath with both nostrils closed.
Close the left and exhale through the right.
Repeat the sequence on the opposite side.
ujjayiSteps: Slightly constrict your throat, inhale through your nose.
Exhale slowly while maintaining slight constriction.
Focus on the soothing "ocean wave" sound.
Keep the rhythm calm and steady.

aboutPage.title: A PROFESSIONAL AND SPECIALIZED DIGITAL PSYCHOLOGY PLATFORM YOU CAN TRUST
aboutPage.intro: A healthy mindset and inner balance define people's psychological well-being and quality of life. Our professional team works to provide the most reliable online session support to individuals facing daily life challenges, seeking to restore their inner peace, or wishing to discover themselves more deeply. We are by your side in a modern digital environment to help you nurture your emotional and psychological well-being.
aboutPage.missionDesc: To provide individuals with professional psychological guidance at various stages of life, making mental health services accessible to everyone through the power of digital technology. Guided by the principles of lifelong growth and inner harmony, we work to improve psychosocial well-being.
visionItems: To make evidence-based services that meet international standards accessible to all.
To play an active role in raising mental health awareness and supporting psychosocial well-being in society.
To support the professional development and knowledge exchange of specialists.
differenceItems: Commitment to ethical codes and confidentiality

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about the NexusMind platform, our services, and data privacy.

items.question: 1. How is my personal data protected?
items.answer: In compliance with international GDPR standards, we fully guarantee the security and confidentiality of your data. Your information is never shared with third parties.

items.question: 2. Who can use the NexusMind platform?
items.answer: Our platform is designed for both individual users (students, professionals, etc.) and corporate partners (psychology and business centers, educational institutions).

items.question: 3. How can I register on the platform?
items.answer: Click the "Sign In" button and enter your email address. Once you enter the verification code sent to your email and answer a few quick onboarding questions, your account will be ready.

items.question: 4. Will my payment be refunded if I cancel a session?
items.answer: If you cancel at least 12 hours prior to the session, your payment will be fully refunded. For cancellations made less than 12 hours before the session, 50% of the paid amount is refunded.

items.question: 5. How do I book a session?
items.answer: Select your preferred date and time on the calendar and complete the payment. Your reservation is confirmed once payment is approved.

faqPage.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Our support team is always ready to assist you. Reach out to us anytime.

termsPage.title: TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE

section1.title: 1. Scope and Definition of Service
section1.p1: NexusMind LLC is a technology platform providing digital mental health services and user support tools through web, mobile, and Virtual Reality (VR) interfaces.
section1.p2: The content and interfaces provided within the platform are available in Azerbaijani, English, and Russian.
section1.p3: NexusMind LLC is not a direct medical center, psychological examination, or treatment facility; it is a high-tech teletherapy and digital mental wellness platform that provides patient referral, session management, a payment ecosystem, and operational coordination.

section2.title: 2. Exclusive Partnership, Psychologist Selection, and Professional Services
section2.p1: The teletherapy and live psychological consultation services offered on the NexusMind platform are delivered by our exclusive strategic partner, Baku Psychology Center (BPM).
section2.p2: All specialists operating within the platform are verified, certified, and experienced psychologists who have passed the specialized selection and interview process of Baku Psychology Center.
section2.p3Text: The user (patient) independently selects their psychologist from the list of BPM specialists available on the platform. If the user is dissatisfied with their chosen psychologist or wishes to continue with another specialist, they may contact NexusMind to request a replacement with another verified BPM specialist. Furthermore, if a psychologist is unable to conduct a consultation for a valid reason, NexusMind may refer the user to another BPM psychologist.
section2.p4Text: Professional services, advice, and confidentiality (psychological confidentiality) provided during psychological sessions are ensured by the specialists in accordance with BPM's Code of Professional Ethics and the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Under no circumstances does NexusMind interfere with the content of the psychological service, the professional decisions of the psychologist, or the methods and outcomes of the consultation.
section2.p5: NexusMind LLC is responsible for the uninterrupted and secure operation of the digital infrastructure (web, mobile, VR), the technical organization of online sessions, and payment processing.

section3.title: 3. Medical Disclaimer, VR Age Restriction, and Emergency Crisis Situations
section3.p1: NexusMind digital tools and VR interfaces are designed to support psychological well-being and do not replace inpatient or emergency medical intervention under standard conditions.
section3.p2Text: If NexusMind detects a situation on the platform that may pose an immediate threat to a patient's life or health, it immediately refers the matter to the designated responsible officer at Baku Psychology Center (BPM). Professional decisions regarding emergency intervention fall under the authority of BPM and the respective psychologist. In the event of a life-threatening emergency, the State Emergency Medical Service (103) must be contacted immediately.
section3.p3Text: The minimum age requirement for using our Virtual Reality (VR) interfaces and equipment is 13 years. Users aged 13–18 may only use VR services with the consent and supervision of their parents or legal guardians.
section3.p4: If dizziness, motion sickness, or physical discomfort occurs while using VR interfaces, the session must be discontinued immediately.

section4.title: 4. Registration, Account Security, Privacy, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)
section4.p1: You are directly responsible for the accuracy of the registration information required to use the platform and for safeguarding your account credentials (password and login details).
section4.p2: The protection of personal data and session records is governed by the Privacy Policy and the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
section4.p3Text: Users' personal, psychological, and health-related data are processed solely for the purpose of delivering the service. Such data may not be used for advertising, marketing, or the commercial interests of third parties without the explicit consent of the user.
section4.p4Label: 4.4. Prohibition of Audio and Video Recordings:
section4.p4Text: Psychological consultations are not recorded in audio or video format. Audio or video recording of a session is only permissible when there is a separate legal basis and written consent from both parties.
section4.p5Text: AI-powered features implemented on the platform do not replace a psychologist's professional judgment, and any recommendation, summary, or analysis generated by AI cannot be considered a final psychological assessment without professional evaluation by a psychologist. Personally identifiable user data is not used for training AI models or for commercial purposes.

section5.title: 5. Session Scheduling, Payments, Cancellation, and "No-Show" Policy
section5.p1: Appointments with Baku Psychology Center specialists are booked online via the platform, and consultation fees are paid through NexusMind's internal payment system.
section5.p2Label: 5.2. Cancellation 12 Hours or More in Advance:
section5.p2Text: For cancellations made 12 hours or more prior to the scheduled session start time, 100% of the paid amount is refunded, or the session is rescheduled to another time.
section5.p3Label: 5.3. Cancellation Less Than 12 Hours in Advance:
section5.p3Text: If the user cancels the consultation less than 12 hours before the session begins, 50% of the paid amount is refunded.
section5.p4Text: If the user fails to join the session at the scheduled appointment time without prior notice and without a valid excuse ("No-Show"), the paid session fee is non-refundable and the service is deemed rendered.
section5.p5Label: 5.5. Sessions Unfulfilled Due to Psychologist or Technical Failure:
section5.p5Text: If a consultation does not take place due to the psychologist's absence or a technical failure directly within NexusMind's scope of responsibility, the user is offered either a 100% refund of the paid amount or, with the user's consent, rescheduling of the session to another time.

section6.title: 6. Intellectual Property Rights
section6.p1: All software, designs, methodologies, brand elements, and audiovisual content located on the www.nexusmind.az platform, mobile application, and VR environments are the property of NexusMind LLC (excluding the brand, logo, and materials belonging to our partner Baku Psychology Center) and are protected by copyright certificates issued by the Intellectual Property Agency of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
section6.p2: Unauthorized copying, distribution, or commercial use of these materials is strictly prohibited.

section7.title: 7. Complaint Management and Limitation of Liability
section7.p1: NexusMind LLC takes all reasonable measures to ensure the continuity of its technical infrastructure, but assumes no liability for issues arising from the user's internet connection, user devices, or global technical outages of third-party infrastructures beyond NexusMind's control (cloud servers, payment gateways, internet service providers).
section7.p2: Direct responsibility for the quality, professional content, and compliance with ethical conduct during consultations conducted by partner psychologists lies with the specialist providing the service and Baku Psychology Center.
section7.p3Text: All initial inquiries and complaints submitted by users are received by NexusMind. Technical complaints are investigated and resolved directly by NexusMind. Complaints regarding a psychologist's professional performance, ethical conduct, or the content of a consultation are forwarded by NexusMind to Baku Psychology Center (BPM) for investigation and appropriate action.

section8.title: 8. Amendments and Applicable Law
section8.p1: NexusMind LLC reserves the right to update these Terms of Use at any time. Amendments take effect immediately upon publication on the website.
section8.p2: These Terms are governed by the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan, and any disputes arising hereunder shall first be resolved through negotiations, or if unresolved, in the competent courts of Baku city.
